coordinate_system: Blender Z-up meters (X=right, Y=depth, Z=up, Lake Z=0.0)

cavern_geology.enclosed_perimeter: 100% enclosed 450m wide x 620-700m deep underground cavern (ZERO side openings/portals to outside sky!)

vertical_canyon_ceiling_fissure.description: Long jagged vertical canyon fissure split overhead in the 185m cavern ceiling opening directly to Full Moon & starry midnight sky

R1_exit_occluder.description: Natural rocky headland on right mid-far shore occluding whale body & radiance during Canon Exit C (66-80s)

luminescence_phases: Phase 0 (0-37s): Unlit wet dark blue-grey + pinpoint eye glint
Phase 1 (37-46s): Organic snout-to-tail wave in Ice-Cyan x Moon-Silver x Lavender-Violet
Phase 2->3 (46-90s): Sculpted Pearl-Opal thin-film iridescence (Ice-Cyan -> Alabaster -> Whisper Sakura-Pink -> Warm Champagne-Gold); stays lit behind R1 during Exit C

flower_spec.closed_state: Dull grey-brown drooping sepals resembling dried weeds
flower_spec.dispersal: Real 2cm translucent white petals + 2-3mm softly glowing champagne-gold seed at base rising like upside-down snow

camera_philosophy.pc_policy: Do NOT fix or depict PC appearance/actions; Camera = Adventurer POV for Act I-III (0-46s)
camera_philosophy.style: A+C Hybrid 16-Cut Architecture: Grounded POV tension & 42mm/68mm Heigei Close-Up Hold -> Gravity-Release Airborne Whale Tracking -> 18mm Grand Mirror-Lake Panorama -> Return to Locked Ground Cam A

cuts_90s.intent: Opening Stillness: Locked Cam A (identical to Cut 16), only P0 lit
P0 Delicate Star-Lily Macro: 4.5cm 5-petal white flowers & golden seed hearts vs surrounding closed buds
Lake Ripples + Giant 24m Submerged Shadow gliding beneath the dark mirror surface
Silent Breach: Unlit wet blue-grey leviathan breaks the obsidian water surface
Close Foreground Approach: Unlit 24m whale glides over the shore toward the adventurer
Heigei Close-Up (Front-20deg): Massive curved snout & long pectoral fins fill the frame
Serene Eye Hold (2.5s stillness): Tight portrait on the whale's calm dark eye & facial contour
Graceful Turn-Back: Whale banks away from shore and rises toward the vertical canyon moonbeam
First Spark: Snout enters the moonbeam; Ice-Cyan & Silver-Violet light ignites the head while the tail stays dark
Phase 1 Ignition Wave & Shore Awakening: Full snout-to-tail luminescence triggers the blooming wave across S1
Mirror-Lake Symmetry: Low-angle water-skimming view of the ignited whale reflected in the glassy lake
Title Beat ('Snow Falling to the Sky'): Ground macro of 2cm petals + glowing gold seeds detaching and rising upward
Gravity Release: Camera lifts off the ground to fly alongside the Pearl-Opal whale through high-parallax golden snow
Grand 450m Cavern Panorama: Vertical canyon Full Moon, Pearl-Opal whale, mirror lake, full bloom, 3000 rising petals
Canon Exit C: Still-glowing whale glides behind the right-hand rocky headland R1; cavern dims by terrain occlusion
Dreamlike Aftermath: Locked Cam A identical to Cut 01; whale is gone, leaving lingering blossoms & faint golden snow
